'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Central Africa Ebola epidemic|2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[International Red Cross]] announces that three of its local volunteers have died from [[Ebola]] while working in the [[Djugu territory|Djugu Territory]], [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (DRC), in March. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/congo-ebola-outbreak-red-cross-workers/ (CBS News)]
**[[India]] issues a travel advisory to [[Uganda]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], and [[South Sudan]] amidst the Ebola outbreak. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/india-govt-travel-advisory-congo-south-sudan-uganda-ebola-outbreak/article71016933.ece/amp/ (''The Hindu'')]
**[[Uganda]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Uganda)|health ministry]] confirms three new Ebola cases, a woman who traveled from the DRC and two Ugandan workers that had contact with her, bringing the country's total to five cases and one death. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20260523-travel-restrictions-on-dr-congo-as-ebola-threat-rises-to-highest-level (RFI)]
